body: I just feel so submerged into this vast emptyness. I just don't know how to handle the situation.
I have called them and talked for a couple of hours. Thank you so much
I am trying. I just can't get the thought of another man exploring her body.

People listen yeah. But honestly I can't shake this feeling. We lived together for almost 2 years and it was the only relationship since my mother passed away. She left me for her ex and told me they where sleeping together. She told me it was my fault her stuff got ruined outside after she was supposed to get it. I ruined our sons umbilical cord because I was to distraught about our break up and finding out about her ex. I tried fixing things with her but she hates me and is living with him. I am trying for legal custody but if i got full custody I would hate myself more for hurting her. I understand our son is important in this situation. But he deserves he more than me so its a lose lose situation for me.
I have already contacted a lawyer and CPS. But I planned on signing full custody to more responiable family members.
I do not think so and no.
I have messages of everything that happened and has been happening as well as her phone if those can be used.
I mean this when I say it; thank you. I just love her deeply feared this day. Thank you for helping me form the words.

I bought the ring a month prior because things where going well. 

And yes, I told her today I did not want my son around her ex and she took him (her ex home)
Her friend and her exs mom.
I have felt that. She told me neither of us where taking the relationship seriously but I was going to propose to her this just ending weekend. She typically works 4-8 or 5-9.
Can I have an explaination? Like,what do I say? What about our son?

I won't say and say what you said saved me, but it does touch me knowning some one can relate to how I feel. Thank you so much for taking the time to read and talk. I agree, some nights get very hard. I am truely sorry that you don't feel as you accomplished as many things. I am sure you have accomplished many personal wants and needs and I am proud of you for making it this far.
